jsonld.description: Family-owned general contractor based in Haile Plantation, Gainesville, Florida, serving Alachua County for over 20 years with kitchen and bathroom remodeling, flooring, cabinets, drywall, painting and commercial buildouts.

eyebrow.es: Gainesville, FL · Remodelación residencial y comercial

parrafo.es: Desde Haile Plantation, en Gainesville, atendemos proyectos residenciales y comerciales en todo el condado de Alachua desde hace más de 20 años. Leo, el dueño, supervisa cada trabajo en persona, desde el primer estimado hasta la entrega final.
parrafo.en: Based in Haile Plantation, Gainesville, we have handled residential and commercial projects across Alachua County for more than 20 years. Leo, the owner, personally oversees every job, from the first estimate to the final walkthrough.

hero.imagen_alt: Fully remodeled kitchen with white cabinets, quartz island and stainless steel appliances by iHome Renovation in Gainesville, FL

parrafo_1.es: iHome Renovation es una empresa familiar con sede en Haile Plantation, Gainesville, con más de 20 años atendiendo el condado de Alachua. Trabajamos remodelaciones de cocina y baño, pisos, gabinetes, drywall, pintura y adecuaciones comerciales, con licencia y seguro.
parrafo_1.en: iHome Renovation is a family-owned company based in Haile Plantation, Gainesville, with more than 20 years serving Alachua County. We handle kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring, cabinets, drywall, painting and commercial buildouts, licensed and insured.

parrafo_2.es: Leo, el dueño, pasa por cada obra una o varias veces al día mientras dura el trabajo, y su equipo se queda hasta terminar cada detalle. Es la razón por la que 25 clientes le dieron 5.0 estrellas en Google.
parrafo_2.en: Leo, the owner, stops by every job site once or several times a day while the work is underway, and his crew stays until every detail is finished. That is why 25 clients gave him 5.0 stars on Google.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas remodelar o reparar y te damos un estimado gratis, sin compromiso.
texto.en: Tell us what you need remodeled or repaired and we will give you a free, no-obligation estimate.

texto.es: Leo visita la propiedad en persona, revisa el alcance del trabajo y te da el precio y el plazo por escrito.
texto.en: Leo visits the property in person, reviews the scope of work, and gives you the price and timeline in writing.

texto.es: El mismo equipo lleva el proyecto de principio a fin, con el dueño pasando por la obra a diario para revisar el avance.
texto.en: The same crew carries the project from start to finish, with the owner stopping by daily to check on progress.

texto.es: Revisamos cada detalle contigo antes de dar el trabajo por terminado, y dejamos el área limpia y despejada.
texto.en: We review every detail with you before calling the job done, and we leave the area clean and clear.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el alcance del trabajo. Llámanos y Leo te visita para darte un precio exacto, sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on the scope of the work. Call us and Leo will visit to give you an exact price, no obligation.

texto.es: Gabinetes, encimeras, islas y electrodomésticos, de principio a fin, con el mismo equipo en toda la obra.
texto.en: Cabinets, countertops, islands and appliances, start to finish, with the same crew on site the whole way through.

texto.es: Duchas a medida, tina independiente, vanidades dobles y azulejo, pensados para durar.
texto.en: Custom showers, freestanding tubs, double vanities and tile work, built to last.

texto.es: Laminado, vinílico y azulejo para casas y negocios, con el mismo patrón distribuido en toda la obra.
texto.en: Laminate, vinyl and tile for homes and businesses, with the pattern kept consistent across every room.

texto.es: Drywall, pintura y acabados para locales y oficinas que necesitan abrir a tiempo.
texto.en: Drywall, painting and finish work for stores and offices that need to open on schedule.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu proyecto en la lista? Llámanos igual, seguro lo hemos hecho antes.
pie.en: Do not see your project on the list? Call us anyway, chances are we have done it before.

items.quote: We had a great experience with our floor installation. The same crew worked the installation from start to finish. Leo, the company owner, came by 1-3 times per day while the flooring was being installed. I do recommend this company.

We would highly recommend Leo and his team for any job. Everything about this company is top-notch. His communication is on point, he really paid attention to what we were looking for. The quality of the work is fantastic.

Excellent experience from start to finish. The team was very professional and attentive to every detail. The quality of the work is impeccable. Without a doubt, I recommend them 100% for any remodeling project.
